memo.summary: Oriel Grid is a low-cost ETF of listed electricity-grid and network infrastructure operators across Europe.
memo.what_it_does: A low-cost ETF holding listed electricity-grid and network infrastructure operators across Europe.
memo.how_it_earns: Holds ~40 regulated network operators; returns come from their regulated asset-base growth and dividends.
bear: Rising gilt yields compress long-duration infrastructure valuations.
A regulator could cut allowed returns in a periodic review.
Concentrated bet on one build programme.
memo.bear_hardest: A coordinated European allowed-return reset would hit the whole fund at once.
gaps: Holdings rebalance quarterly; real-time weights are not public.

tv.summary: Oriel Grid is a low-cost ETF of listed electricity-grid and network infrastructure operators across Europe.
tv.variant_view: Grid spend is a regulated, inflation-linked build programme; the fund gives diversified exposure without single-utility regulatory risk.
tv.assumptions: ["grid capex programmes proceed on schedule","rates stabilise"]
tv.catalysts: National grid investment-plan approvals; rate decisions.
tv.risks: Rising gilt yields compress the valuation of long-duration infrastructure.
tv.invalidation: A major member cuts its regulated-asset-base growth guidance.
tv.exit_conditions: Thesis invalidated, or the position reaches its target weight through price alone.
tv.reason_for_change: Tightened the invalidation condition after the interim update.
